Edinburgh AI startup Quicksilver closes £3.2m Series A

4 August 2026

Quicksilver, an Edinburgh-based AI company, has closed a £3.2m Series A round led by a London growth fund with participation from Scottish Enterprise.

The company builds geospatial foundation models that let insurers price flood risk at the level of an individual building rather than a postcode. It was founded in 2024 by two former University of Edinburgh researchers and now employs 21 people.

“Flood maps in this country are a decade out of date,” said the chief executive. “We rebuild them every fortnight from satellite imagery.”

The round takes total funding to £4.6m. Quicksilver plans to double its engineering team and open a small office in Bristol.
